name: _pref-close.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  modal/_pref-close.scss — the circular WebGL pref-close button inside the expand modal (canvas icon + fallback).
//  Imported by modal.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Circular close button inside the expand modal (smaller than the pref dialog's).
.#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-btn {
  @extend %RESETBTN;

  -webkit-appearance: none;

  appearance: none;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: to-rem($space-3xl);
  height: to-rem($space-3xl);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  outline: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: none;

  &::before,
  &::after {
    content: none;
    border: none;
  }

  .#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-canvas {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    display: block;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
}
